# Swiper

Touch-friendly carousels, sliders and swipeable media galleries for generated
sites.

```html
<link rel="stylesheet" href="vendor/swiper/swiper-bundle.min.css">
<script src="vendor/swiper/swiper-bundle.min.js"></script>
```

Load the CSS in `<head>` and the script before `</body>`; exposes the global
`Swiper`. MIT licensed — see `LICENSE` and `UPSTREAM.md`.
